v24-15.candidate: On the same day you shall pay his wages; the sun shall not go down upon them, for he is poor and sets his hope upon them; lest he cry against you unto the Lord, and there be sin in you.

v25-13.candidate: You shall not have in your pouch differing weights, a great or a small.

v25-14.candidate: You shall not have in your house differing measures, a great or a small.
